hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street can hide pedestrians, especially children, who may attempt to cross mid-block.

hazards.name: Wide, straight roadway
hazards.description: The long, straight stretch of asphalt with clear sightlines may encourage vehicle speeds higher than appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated pedestrian crossing is visible in this segment, which may encourage unsafe mid-block crossing behavior.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars along both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Profile
hazards.description: The relatively wide, straight roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line create a visual barrier between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Straight Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, straight geometry of the travel lanes without traffic calming may encourage vehicle speeds that exceed safe limits for a residential area.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk is directly adjacent to the parking lane with no physical or landscape buffer, reducing the comfort and perceived safety of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and weeds growing through the sidewalk pavement create potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at regular intervals to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically slow vehicle traffic in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Clear all encroaching vegetation and repair the sidewalk surface to provide a continuous, level, and unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to a minimum of 5-6 feet to meet ADA standards and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting specifically aimed at the sidewalk to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard crosswalk markings to a continental pattern to improve visibility under harsh lighting conditions.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Increase the density of street trees to provide shade and help mitigate the effects of direct sun glare.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk where the crossing sign is located to clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a safety buffer and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Adding a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and potentially a pedestrian-activated beacon to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Tree Canopy
interventions.description: Increase the density of street trees to provide shade and help mitigate the effects of direct sun glare on the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical barriers such as bollards or planters to separate the bike lane from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Replace the dead tree trunk with a new street tree to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and act as a vertical traffic calming element.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions or humps to physically reduce vehicle speeds along this residential block.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees in the buffer zone to improve the pedestrian experience, provide shade, and help calm traffic.

interventions.title: Vertical Deflection
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface or replace cracked sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furnishings
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the temporary flex posts with permanent concrete curb extensions to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time on this wide roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage
interventions.description: Add pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Street-Level Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved, and ADA-compliant sidewalk at the street grade to provide a safe and accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Street Tree Canopy Enhancement
interventions.description: Planting larger street trees can provide shade to reduce glare and create a visual narrowing effect that naturally encourages slower vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Pruning or removing overgrown bushes to restore the full width of the sidewalk and improve visibility.
